title: 第15章 反杀！秃鹫帮
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
陈安的目标很明确。

    气血丹！

    陈安的目光如鹰隼般在人群中搜寻，径直穿过嘈杂的区域，走向了溶洞深处一个相对冷清的角落，那里，飘散着一股浓郁的药材味道。

    最终，他在一个光线最为昏暗的摊位前停下了脚步。

    摊主是个身形枯槁的男人，整个人都笼罩在宽大的黑袍里，脸上戴着一张森然的白骨面具，只露出一双闪烁着幽幽绿光的眼睛。

    他的摊位上，只孤零零地摆着几个大小不一的瓷瓶，以及几本泛黄的册子。

    一股精纯的药香，混杂着一丝极淡的血腥味，从其中一个瓷瓶中若有若无地飘出。

    就是它了。

    陈安伸出干枯的手指，点了点那个白色的瓷瓶，用刻意磨砺过的沙哑嗓音问道：“气血丹，何价？”

    白骨面具之下，传来公鸭般难听刺耳的声音。

    “四两银子，一粒。”

    陈安心头一动。

    市面上，由官府认证的药铺售卖的气血丹，一粒五两银子，且供不应求。

    这里便宜了一两，丹药的来路，绝对不正。

    不是从哪个倒霉蛋的尸体上扒下来的，就是某个不入流的炼丹师私下炼制的次品，药性不纯。

    但陈安不在乎。

    他的根骨早已非比常人，《鲸吞功》大成，足以消化一切。

    他没有半分犹豫，直接从怀里掏出那个沉甸甸的钱袋，倒出八两碎银，放在了摊位上。

    “两枚。”

    动作干脆利落，没有一句废话。

    那摊主眼中的绿光闪了闪，似乎有些意外这个看起来快要入土的老家伙竟如此爽快。他伸出同样干瘦的手，将银子扫进袍子，然后把一个装着两枚丹药的小瓶推了过来。

    陈安一把将小瓶揣进怀里，用体温将其捂热。

    就在他准备转身离去时，目光不经意地扫过摊位上的另外几本武学册子。

    《残篇——碎石拳》。

    《速成追风步》。

    一股强烈的渴望在他心中一闪而过。

    但他立刻便将这股念头死死掐灭。
content_en:
Chen An's goal is very clear.

    Qi and blood pill!

    Chen An's eyes searched the crowd like a hawk, and he walked straight through the noisy area and walked to a relatively deserted corner deep in the cave, where a strong smell of medicinal herbs wafted.

    Finally, he stopped in front of a booth with the dimmest lighting.

    The stall owner was a haggard man, his whole body shrouded in a wide black robe, and his face was wearing a gloomy white bone mask, only revealing a pair of eyes with a faint green light.

    On his stall, there were only a few porcelain bottles of different sizes and a few yellowed booklets.

    A pure medicinal fragrance, mixed with a very faint smell of blood, floated out from one of the porcelain bottles.

    This is it.

    Chen An stretched out his withered finger, tapped the white porcelain bottle, and asked in a hoarse voice that had been deliberately honed: "What's the price of the Qi and Blood Pill?"

    Under the bone mask, a harsh and unpleasant voice like a drake came.

    "Four taels of silver, one grain."

    Chen An's head moved.

    On the market, Qi and Blood Pills sold by government-certified pharmacies cost five taels of silver each, and demand exceeded supply.

    It's a tael cheaper here, and the origin of the elixir is definitely not correct.

    Either it was ripped from the corpse of some unlucky person, or it was a defective product secretly refined by some unscrupulous alchemist. The medicinal properties were impure.

    But Chen An doesn't care.

    His bones are already extraordinary than those of ordinary people, and his "Whale Swallowing Skill" is enough to digest everything.

    Without any hesitation, he took out the heavy money bag from his arms, poured out eight taels of broken silver, and placed it on the stall.

    "Two."

    The movements were crisp and clear, without a word of nonsense.

    The green light in the stall owner's eyes flashed, and he seemed a little surprised that this old guy who looked like he was about to die was so cheerful. He stretched out the same thin hand, swept the silver into his robe, and then pushed over a small bottle containing two pills.

    Chen An put the vial into his arms and covered it with his body temperature.

    Just as he was about to turn around and leave, his eyes inadvertently glanced at several other martial arts books on the stall.

    "Remaining Chapter - Stone Fist".

    "Quick Wind Chasing Step".

    A strong desire flashed through his heart.

    But he immediately suppressed this thought.
